cards.standardPhrase: What are you going to do?
cards.phrase: Whatcha gonna do?
cards.translation: Что ты собираешься делать?

cards.standardPhrase: I've got to go.
cards.phrase: I've gotta go.
cards.translation: Мне пора идти.

cards.standardPhrase: Don't you know?
cards.phrase: Dontcha know?
cards.translation: Разве ты не знаешь?

cards.standardPhrase: I want to go home.
cards.phrase: I wanna go home.
cards.translation: Я хочу домой.

cards.standardPhrase: Tell them to wait.
cards.phrase: Tell 'em to wait.
cards.translation: Скажи им подождать.

cards.standardPhrase: How are you doing?
cards.phrase: How ya doing?
cards.translation: Как у тебя дела?

cards.standardPhrase: Got you! Just a couple of minutes.
cards.phrase: Gotcha! Just a coupla minutes.
cards.translation: Понял тебя! Всего пару минут.

cards.standardPhrase: What are you doing?
cards.phrase: Whatcha doing?
cards.translation: Что ты делаешь?

cards.standardPhrase: Do I have to?
cards.phrase: Do I hafta?
cards.translation: Мне обязательно это делать?

cards.standardPhrase: Do you want to come?
cards.phrase: D'ya wanna come?
cards.translation: Хочешь пойти с нами?

cards.standardPhrase: Did you see that? Did you get it?
cards.phrase: Didja see that? Didja get it?
cards.translation: Ты это видел? Ты понял?

cards.standardPhrase: Where did you go? You could have told me.
cards.phrase: Where'dja go? You coulda told me.
cards.translation: Куда ты ходил? Мог бы мне сказать.

cards.standardPhrase: How did you know? How did you do that?
cards.phrase: How'dja know? How'dja do that?
cards.translation: Как ты узнал? Как ты это сделал?

cards.standardPhrase: What did you say? What did you do?
cards.phrase: Whadja say? Whadja do?
cards.translation: Что ты сказал? Что ты сделал?

cards.standardPhrase: Do you know? Could you help me?
cards.phrase: D'ya know? Couldja help me?
cards.translation: Ты знаешь? Не мог бы ты мне помочь?

cards.standardPhrase: Would you mind? I don't want to do it.
cards.phrase: Wouldja mind? I don't wanna do it.
cards.translation: Ты не против? Я не хочу этого делать.

cards.standardPhrase: Do you want to come? It's going to be okay.
cards.phrase: Wanna come? It's gonna be okay.
cards.translation: Хочешь пойти с нами? Всё будет хорошо.

cards.standardPhrase: I have to go. I'm supposed to be there.
cards.phrase: I hafta go. I'm supposedta be there.
cards.translation: Мне нужно идти. Я должен быть там.

cards.standardPhrase: Don't you want to come? Give me a second.
cards.phrase: Don'tcha wanna come? Gimme a second.
cards.translation: Разве ты не хочешь пойти? Дай мне секунду.

cards.standardPhrase: Look at that! Why did you do that?
cards.phrase: Lookit that! Why'dja do that?
cards.translation: Посмотри на это! Зачем ты это сделал?

cards.standardPhrase: Could you say that again?
cards.phrase: Couldja say that again?
cards.translation: Не мог бы ты повторить?

cards.standardPhrase: Would you like some coffee?
cards.phrase: Wouldja like some coffee?
cards.translation: Хочешь кофе?

cards.standardPhrase: Can't you see? You've got to see this.
cards.phrase: Cantcha see? You've gotta see this.
cards.translation: Разве ты не видишь? Ты должен это увидеть.

cards.standardPhrase: Give me a hand. I'm out of here.
cards.phrase: Gimme a hand. I'm outta here.
cards.translation: Помоги мне. Я ухожу.

cards.standardPhrase: Where are you going? I don't know.
cards.phrase: Where ya going? I dunno.
cards.translation: Куда ты идёшь? Я не знаю.

cards.standardPhrase: Tell him to call. He has to work.
cards.phrase: Tell 'im to call. He hasta work.
cards.translation: Скажи ему позвонить. Ему нужно работать.

cards.standardPhrase: Let me see. I used to live here.
cards.phrase: Lemme see. I usedta live here.
cards.translation: Дай посмотреть. Раньше я жил здесь.

cards.standardPhrase: Give me a minute. Ask her about it.
cards.phrase: Gimme a minute. Ask 'er about it.
cards.translation: Дай мне минуту. Спроси её об этом.

cards.standardPhrase: Did you eat yet? I'll get you one.
cards.phrase: Didja eat yet? I'll getcha one.
cards.translation: Ты уже поел? Я принесу тебе один.

cards.standardPhrase: What's your name? You must have forgotten.
cards.phrase: What's yer name? You musta forgotten.
cards.translation: Как тебя зовут? Ты, должно быть, забыл.

cards.standardPhrase: I don't know what you mean. It's kind of hard.
cards.phrase: I dunno whatcha mean. It's kinda hard.
cards.translation: Я не знаю, что ты имеешь в виду. Это довольно сложно.

cards.standardPhrase: See you later. Talk to you soon.
cards.phrase: See ya later. Talk to ya soon.
cards.translation: Увидимся позже. Скоро поговорим.

cards.standardPhrase: How do you feel? I need a cup of coffee.
cards.phrase: How d'ya feel? I need a cuppa coffee.
cards.translation: Как ты себя чувствуешь? Мне нужна чашка кофе.

cards.standardPhrase: Let me know. I'll meet you there.
cards.phrase: Lemme know. I'll meetcha there.
cards.translation: Дай мне знать. Я встречу тебя там.

cards.standardPhrase: I should have called. I should have told you.
cards.phrase: I shoulda called. I shoulda toldja.
cards.translation: Мне следовало позвонить. Мне следовало тебе сказать.

cards.standardPhrase: Let me try. That's a lot of money.
cards.phrase: Lemme try. That's a lotta money.
cards.translation: Дай мне попробовать. Это большие деньги.

cards.standardPhrase: When did you get here? Where's your phone?
cards.phrase: When didja get here? Where's yer phone?
cards.translation: Когда ты сюда приехал? Где твой телефон?

cards.standardPhrase: Who did you talk to? I bet you he knows.
cards.phrase: Who'dja talk to? I betcha he knows.
cards.translation: С кем ты разговаривал? Спорим, он знает.

cards.standardPhrase: I would have gone. What do you mean?
cards.phrase: I woulda gone. Whaddaya mean?
cards.translation: Я бы пошёл. Что ты имеешь в виду?
